lines.say: Which building is the tallest on Earth? Let's build the top five, one by one.
lines.caption: Tallest buildings
lines.cap: Which building is the tallest on Earth? Let's build the top five, one by one.

lines.say: Number five. Ping An Finance Center, in Shenzhen. Five hundred ninety-nine meters.
lines.caption: #5 Ping An
lines.cap: Number five. Ping An Finance Center, in Shenzhen. 599 meters.

lines.say: Number four. The Makkah Royal Clock Tower. Six hundred and one meters.
lines.caption: #4 Clock Tower
lines.cap: Number four. The Makkah Royal Clock Tower. 601 meters.

lines.say: Number three. Shanghai Tower, with its famous twist. Six hundred thirty-two meters.
lines.caption: #3 Shanghai Tower
lines.cap: Number three. Shanghai Tower, with its famous twist. 632 meters.

lines.say: Number two. Merdeka one-eighteen, in Kuala Lumpur. Six hundred seventy-nine meters.
lines.caption: #2 Merdeka 118
lines.cap: Number two. Merdeka 118, in Kuala Lumpur. 679 meters.

lines.say: And number one. Burj Khalifa, in Dubai. Eight hundred twenty-eight meters.
lines.caption: #1 Burj Khalifa
lines.cap: And number one. Burj Khalifa, in Dubai. 828 meters.

lines.say: But in Saudi Arabia, Jeddah Tower is still rising. The plan? More than one kilometer tall.
lines.caption: Jeddah Tower
lines.cap: But in Saudi Arabia, Jeddah Tower is still rising. The plan? More than 1 kilometer tall.
